title: Gashi mai laushi, ranar wankewa da tsabta, amintaccen wurin aiki

say: Gashi mai laushi, ranar wankewa, da tsaftataccen wurin aiki mai aminci.
Wannan bidiyon ne don module ɗaya na Kula da Gashi da Salon Sauƙi.
Afro-textured gashi ba wuya ko mummunan gashi. Bangaren da kuke gani mataccen furotin ne da ake kira keratin, don haka da zarar ya lalace, ba zai iya warkewa ba. Rigakafin shine komai.

say: Misali, Amaka da ke Onitsha ta cire gashin Blessing bayan sati bakwai, kuma Blessing ta damu da gashin da ke cikin tsefe.
Gashin da aka zubar suna da ɗan ƙaramin farin kwan fitila a ƙarshen tushen. Wasu zubarwa a kowace rana al'ada ce, kuma suturar sutura suna kama shi.

say: Gajerun guntuka marasa kwan fitila sun karye. Yawancin sun fito ne daga nape, inda braids sun kasance mafi ƙanƙanta kuma mafi bushewa. Don haka lokaci na gaba, Amaka yana sa ƙwanƙolin nape ɗin ya ɓata kuma ya ɗan girma.

Combs da clips sun kai kimanin naira 6,000. Kafa uku da tawul shida, don haka ta iya jujjuya su, kusan 12,000.
